summary: Four Leaf Acquisition Corp (a SPAC) filed an 8-K reporting its entry into a Business Combination Agreement on August 27, 2026 with Data443 Risk Mitigation, Inc. and a merger subsidiary. The structure involves a parent merger into a newly formed Nevada corporation (NewCo), followed by a merger of the subsidiary with Data443, making Data443 a wholly-owned subsidiary of NewCo. Data443 shareholders receive NewCo stock as consideration. The filing is an initial SPAC business combination announcement; no financial terms, premium, or advisors disclosed. Watch for shareholder approval and redemptions. Risk-arb: monitor target valuation, deal pricing, and regulatory timeline.
